getting_started_add_folder_instructions: Choose {#b}Add a folder{/b} below, or use {#b}Library manager{/b}. Your files stay where they are.

getting_started_larger_models: Larger models search more accurately. Pick one in {#b}Settings → Search{/b}.
getting_started_reopen_hint: Reopen this guide from {#b}Settings → Getting started{/b}.
getting_started_search_menu_image_alt: Search menu with All, Visual search, and File name above Exact text and Related text
getting_started_search_menu_intro: Use the search menu, or type a prefix:
getting_started_search_menu_options: {#b}All{/b} combines available searches; {#b}File name{/b} searches names only. Exact and related text need text recognition.
getting_started_search_type_visual: {#b}Visual search{/b} ({#code}like:{/code}): describe a photo or video, or use an example image.
getting_started_sort_and_filter_help: {#b}Relevance{/b} groups results; {#b}Date{/b} puts them on a timeline. {#b}Visual similarity{/b} narrows visual matches. Try {#code}during:2020-12{/code} to limit a search to a month.
getting_started_text_recognition_tip: For words inside pictures, turn on {#b}Text recognition{/b} in Library manager.

getting_started_visual_search_setup: Visual search is set up automatically. The first run downloads a search model; your files stay on your computer.
getting_started_visual_search_steps: Right-click a file: {#b}Find similar images{/b} starts a search; {#b}Add to visual search{/b} adds another example.
image_model_danbooru_siglip_compact: Danbooru-trained for anime and art; less useful elsewhere. Very slow indexing.
image_model_danbooru_siglip_description: Specialty model trained on Danbooru tags. Good for anime and art, less useful elsewhere. About as fast as PE L/14.
image_model_dinov3_compact: Fast image examples with Visualize. No text descriptions.
image_model_dinov3_description: Fast image search. Try Visualize to see which areas match your example. Does not search from descriptions.
image_model_embeddinggemma2_140_compact: 70 tokens with more image detail. Slowest indexing.
image_model_embeddinggemma2_140_descript: Same as EmbeddingGemma 2 70 tokens, but looks at images in more detail. The slowest to index. Same 1.8 GB download.
image_model_embeddinggemma2_70_compact: New architecture to experiment with. Very slow indexing; 1.8 GB.
image_model_embeddinggemma2_70_descripti: A new architecture that reads images with a language model. Useful to experiment with, but not generally recommended. Slower to index than MetaCLIP2 L/14. 1.8 GB download.
image_model_metaclip2_b16_compact: Better small writing than B/32; similar speed on a GPU.
image_model_metaclip2_b16_description: Reads small text or writing in a photo more reliably than B/32. About as fast with a real GPU, so it's an easy upgrade if you have one. Much slower on integrated graphics.
image_model_metaclip2_b32_compact: Fast general search; may miss small writing.
image_model_metaclip2_b32_description: Fast, and good for most searches. May miss small text or writing in a photo. Best choice for integrated graphics.
image_model_metaclip2_l14_compact: Best MetaCLIP2 for small writing. Very slow indexing; 3 GB.
image_model_metaclip2_l14_description: The most reliable MetaCLIP2 model for reading small text in a photo. Very slow to index. 3 GB download.
image_model_pe_b16_compact: Finds different matches than MetaCLIP2. Needs a real GPU. 1.7 GB.
image_model_pe_b16_description: A different model family from MetaCLIP2 that finds different matches. Try it when a search misses. Nearly as fast as B/32 on a real GPU; much slower on integrated graphics. 1.7 GB download.
image_model_pe_l14_compact: Larger PE B/16, also unlike MetaCLIP2. Very slow indexing; 2.5 GB.
image_model_pe_l14_description: Larger version of PE B/16, so it also finds different matches than MetaCLIP2. Slower to index than EmbeddingGemma 2 70 tokens. 2.5 GB download.
image_model_siglip2_compact: Scenes and poses; weaker on small writing. Similar size to MetaCLIP2 B/16.
image_model_siglip2_description: Good for scenes and poses. May miss small writing in a photo that MetaCLIP2 can find. Similar size to MetaCLIP2 B/16.
